store.description: General merchandise retailer offering groceries, household essentials, clothing, and electronics. Also features seasonal items, home decor, party supplies, and toys. Exclusive collections and sports fan merchandise are available. Products can be purchased online or in physical stores. The business has a long history of community giving.

top_reviews.text:
I called from the Janesville store to ask a question and the girls in the other end were slightly rude, but not to the point I wasn’t going to drive 40 minutes to get the switch 2 Pokémon edition. 
I need to shout out Tucker. He went out of his way to interact with my son. My 8 year old has a few “quirks ” send Tucker acknowledged them, interacted with him on a level that made my child talk non-stop about Pokémon and Tucker, the entire way home. The stickers that Tucker gave to him after we bought the switch 2 bundle were more valuable than the $500 console. 
I don’t know if employees can read this but I need to let Tucker know that he made a difference in that little curly haired boys night. He wants to come back to visit with Tucker and take about Pokémon❤️

I ordered the Im Nayeon album from target and the buy 2 get 1 free deal was amazing! Along with that I got free shipping which made it even better!!! The website was easy to navigate and check out was fast and clear. I would really recommend buying something online from target even if you do go wnd pick it up because thats just as easy!!!! Also I definitely recommend getting the IM NAYEON album it has lots fun inclusions and great songs pre order, buy in store (june 25th) or don't and cry because you spent money on some lame Billie Eilish.  Shop online at target!!!!!!

reviews.text: Today I purchased a magic the gathering deck that had cards in it that I was looking for. I was in store and chose to pick it up and when they told me the price it sounded weird but my phone was not functioning properly at the time and I could not pull up the price to verify. I chose to purchase it knowing that the target policy was that I would be able to get it price matched to their website provided it was cheaper when I found it online. When I left the store I found it for cheaper on their own website. When I looked at the receipt, I also noticed that the item said cannot be returned, but nobody ever mentioned this at checkout. When I went to customer service in store to attempt to get it rectified and get a refund for the difference. I was told that the item numbers do not match and that it is not the same item. There were no more printings of this deck, meaning that it was in fact the exact same item. This explanation was not good enough and I was told that I was not able to get my refund either in full or for the difference. Upon calling customer service I attempted to explain to them right on the phone that it was the exact same item and they disagreed as well. Target will price gouge you then refuse to let you return an unopened item purchased same day with receipt in hand. I will likely never shop here ever again after this

The ease, availability, and quick shipping time is ALWAYS on point.  However, the packaging of the products I ordered was hideous!  I ordered 2 jugs of tide, 3 jugs of fabric softener, 2 jugs of laundry refresher and 3 canisters of the scent beads.  Yes, Im a little obsessed with my laundry smelling good.  The box they shipped my detergent and fabric softener in was about three times the size it needed to be.  They threw in some of the paper wrap and sent it on out.  No tape over the lids of anything.  They were rolling around like kids in the back of the Griswolds station wagon.  When I opened the box, sure enough, the fabric softener was leaking.  I wiped it all down and put it away.  The smaller box contained the scent beads and the fabric refresher.  These didn't have any packing materials, no tape on the lids to ensure they stayed closed and just rolling round in the box.  One of the fabric refresher bottles also leaked.  Target is my normal go to.  I may have to reconsider since I don't have one close and I'm going to receive my packages like this?  Do better Target...do better.

Arrived damaged and leaking in the delivery box.This was delivered by USPS & it was obvious that the dented and damp box had been thrown around and damaged in their care. The internal packaging made me question whether or not the items were sufficiently packed by Target employees though. Bubble wrap nor other good insulation was used. Items were in the box with loose shipping type brown paper. Bubble wrap would have been more protective. Either that or perhaps they should look at using a different shipper. When I called my local neighborhood Target to let them know & to see if I could bring the damaged box with product to them, the phone rang a long time then someone picked the phone up and hung up. This was at the Natomas store & typical of them, and or not answering the phone at all. My customer service complaints about this on the Target App have not changed anything so I'm calling them out on this publicly. After calling back & finally a guy answering, he told me I would need to file a claim with the post office. I told him I didn't think this was right so he said he would transfer me to a manager. After 10 minutes and no one coming to the phone, I hung up and went to the Target store with the package. The lady who helped me was impatient and lacking in customer service skills but at least I got credit for the product, hence the one star. I now know it is their policy to handle damaged products like this with their own internal claims process. The employee I spoke with initially by phone should have known better. Target, train your employees better!

Target and shipt lost a customer. I will NEVER shop there again. Shipt is the WORST delivery service I've ever dealt with.  I placed an order at 3:52 pm with a delivery time between 5-7. I received a message that my order was being shopped, Gavin messaged me about a substitution. 50 minutes later, I messaged Gavin to ask if he was at Target. He asked for my address and order number.  He then tells me he doesn't have my order. He never had my order.  So I guess Shipt lied when they said Gavin was shopping for my order. I must have imagined receiving a message from Gavin asking for approval for a substitution.  I got another message saying my order would be delivered 7-8. I got another message saying it would be delivered 8-9.Then I got another one saying my order would be delivered Dec. 26th!! I called customer service.I was told Gavin told them the store was closing, which is a total lie! He stated my order of 12 items at 6:35, the store was open until 8:00. I'm positive his phone jingled from shipt for an order for more money than my $85.00 order, so he stopped shopping my order to shop their's.  You don't get more unprofessional, rude, and greedier than thar. I'm disabled and no longer drive.  For Target and Shipt to contact me FOUR HOURS after I placed my order to tell me the Christmas presents I ordered wouldn't be delivered until TWO DAYS after I placed my SAME DAY DELIVERY order is egregious, and so so so unprofessional. I'll use Amazon from now on.  You can depend and trust your order will be delivered when they say, and you don't have to worry if their delivery driver is greedy and inconsiderate.

I placed an online order for almost $50 for two bottles of retinol lotion (this stuff ain’t cheap). The website said it will be delivered today, 3 or 4 days later, so I went ahead with the order. I got an email while I was out saying that my package had been delivered so when I got home at 7:15 PM, I noticed it was not there. I called customer service and they told me that even though it says it was delivered, it may not have been delivered. This is the craziest thing I’ve ever heard. He would not refund my money or anything. He told me I had to wait a couple of days to see if it would be delivered. This is a total waste of my time and the worst Customer Service I’ve ever had at Target! All I gotta say is if you don’t get your order delisted on time, prepare to wait — and hope they refund your money. And by the way, this order originally started out as a same-day delivery, but Target kept pushing the time back or whoever they use to pick up their orders kept pushing the time back until it was 11 o’clock at night. I waited around for a couple of hours and then called them and told them to cancel the order, which they did, but I had the lotion mailed to me. Target Customer Service is horrible!
